root_idea.summary: The root has two principal orientations: division into a half or portion, and distance or facing toward a side or direction.
root_idea.development: The division branch yields meanings of halving, sharing, partial portions, and paired halves. The distance-and-facing branch yields remoteness, estrangement, and the directional use of شَطْرٌ for the side or direction toward which one turns.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The QAC group is a Quran-attested nominal form and is displayed under the normalized citation headword شَطْرٌ.

senses.definition: The direction, side, or quarter toward which one turns or aims.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quran occurrences, it appears in the construction of turning the face toward the Sacred Mosque, including شَطْرَهُ, “toward/in its direction.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To halve or divide something into two halves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb; its verbal noun is شَطْرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To milk one half of an animal’s teats and leave the other half unmilked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a she-camel, ewe, or goat; the relevant half may consist of a pair of teats or, for a smaller animal, one teat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a ewe or goat, to have one teat dried up or one teat longer than the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive animal-related use describing unequal or impaired teats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide one’s gaze between two persons or objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes looking toward one person and another at the same time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair or betake oneself in the direction of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal directional construction distinct from the noun شَطْرٌ used as a direction or side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a house or abode, to be distant or remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used predicatively of a dwelling or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw far from one’s family, break off from them in anger, or disagree with them through troublesome or wicked conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is used of separation or hostile estrangement from one’s family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bind two of an animal’s teats, leaving the other two unbound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a she-camel; the binding is done with a صِرَار.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide property equally with another, retaining one half and giving the other half.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III sharing construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave one teat for a lamb or kid after milking the other and binding it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A livestock-management use involving the mother’s milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Half of a thing; by related extension, half of a measure or verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is used for a literal half, including half a measured quantity and, in prosody, half a verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part, portion, or some amount of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended or nonliteral use, including a portion of an action or quantity rather than exactly one half.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either pair of a she-camel’s four teats, or either teat of a ewe or she-goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term names a corresponding half or pair within the animal’s milk-producing organs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom حَلَبَ الدَّهْرَ أَشْطُرَهُ, to have experienced the varied conditions of fortune, both hardship and prosperity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom based on milking the different pairs of an animal’s teats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distance or remoteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal meaning distinct from the directional sense and from the verb meaning to travel toward a direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A condition in which someone’s offspring are half male and half female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person’s offspring as a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Half full, said of a bowl or other vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective has feminine شَطْرَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Uneven or asymmetrical: an animal with unequal or dried teats, or a garment whose two breadth-ends are unequal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the explicitly attested animal and garment cases; the common feature is imbalance between corresponding sides or parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distant or remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a town, country, abode, tribe, tract, or a far-reaching intention or aim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stranger, or one who is alone or solitary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is associated with remoteness from one’s people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who breaks away from family, disagrees with them, or is morally wayward, wicked, mischievous, or deceitful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical range includes one who takes a wrong course and one who troubles or exhausts his family by bad conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who outstrips others or advances with exceptional speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use may describe a swift traveler; in a mystical application it describes one quick to attain nearness to God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clever, cunning person; in a later usage, a sharper or clever thief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an attested later or current extension of the headword’s lexical range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Halved or having half removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In prosody, applied to a verse from which three of its six feet are missing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bread covered with the condiment called كَامَخ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use distinct from the participial meaning “halved.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Neighboring or having a house adjoining another’s.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persons whose houses adjoin one another.

cautions: The Quranic form is the normalized noun citation شَطْرٌ, while the supplied Quran occurrences are its directional accusative forms such as شَطْرَ and شَطْرَهُ. The classical half and portion meanings are therefore kept separate from the Quran-attested directional sense.
